findings.title: contestants.length always 0 in sub-events grid
findings.description: Sub-event objects are built from the Firestore event root document using `sd.contestants || []`. Contestants are stored only as a sub-collection (events/{id}/contestants), never as an array field on the document, so `sd.contestants` is always undefined and resolves to []. The template expression `{{contestants.length}}` renders '0 contestants' for every sub-event card regardless of actual count.
findings.correction: Either fetch the contestant sub-collection count for each sub-event inside the existing try block, or remove the contestants count from the sub-event card.

findings.title: Deleting a child event leaves a stale ID in parent's subEvents array
findings.description: deleteEvent only cleans up children when a parent is deleted. When a child (sub-event) is deleted, its ID is never removed from the parent's subEvents array. arrayRemove is not imported and is not called. The parent show page then renders a broken card linking to the deleted document, and the sub-event count in both show.xian and index.xian is permanently inflated.
findings.correction: When deleting an event whose parentEventId is non-empty, call updateDoc on the parent document with arrayRemove(req.params.id). Import arrayRemove from firebase/firestore.
